description: NotebookLM for a dreamteamer workspace: export and sync the workspace as notebook sources, and keep each notebook as a record it is restored from.

dreamteamer.title: NotebookLM
dreamteamer.description: NotebookLM for a dreamteamer workspace. `dt notebooklm` exports the schema and records as sources and syncs them into a notebook; the `notebooklm` harness keeps NOTEBOOKLM.md's persona and settings current. A `notebooks` record holds a notebook's ordered sources, chat settings, id and login, which `npx dt-notebook` restores and captures. Sensitive collections and fields never travel.
